t: The Bosch SDS Plus Chisel Set provides essential tools for demolition and chasing tasks. This professional-grade collection includes pointed, 20mm flat, and 40mm spade chisels, making it ideal for breaking up concrete, mortar, plaster, and tile in various construction and renovation projects. Each chisel is manufactured from high-grade steel with a specialised hardening process, ensuring exceptional durability and a long working life on site. The SDS Plus shank offers secure fitting and efficient power transfer. Supplied in a robust tube for convenient storage and transport, this set delivers reliable performance for demanding masonry work.
b: SDS Plus Shank For Secure Fitting
Flat Edge Breaks Concrete & Masonry Effectively
Wide Edge Ensures Higher Material Removal
